entities.summary: Ramathibodi I, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Ayutthaya Kingdom (1351–1569). Preceded by King Ramathibodi I founds Ayutthaya. Their legacy influenced Ayutthaya attacks and sacks Angkor and Revolution of 1688 — Phaulkon executed and French expelled.
